description: This file contains utility functions for managing sharded tensors within the PyTorch distributed framework. It includes functions for device validation, metadata construction, and consistency checks across distributed shards, tailored for use in distributed tensor sharding scenarios.

classes.name: ShardedTensorMetadata
classes.description: Class representing the metadata of a sharded tensor, including shard specifications and tensor properties.

classes.name: TensorProperties
classes.description: Class encapsulating tensor attribute properties such as dtype, layout, requires_grad, memory_format, and pin_memory.

classes.name: Shard
classes.description: Represents a shard of a tensor, including its tensor data and associated metadata.

methods.name: _parse_and_validate_remote_device(pg, remote_device)
methods.description: Validates and extracts the worker ID and device for a given remote device object.

methods.name: None _validate_output_tensor_for_gather( my_rank: int, dst_rank: int, size: torch.Size, dst_tensor: torch.Tensor | None, )
methods.description: Ensures the output tensor provided for a gather operation matches expected size and rank conditions.

methods.name: torch.Size _flatten_tensor_size(size)
methods.description: Validates and flattens a tensor size specification into a torch.Size object.

methods.name: _raise_if_mismatch(expected, actual, prop_name, ranks, is_local=True)
methods.description: Checks for mismatches in tensor properties across local or distributed shards and raises errors if mismatches are found.

methods.name: ShardedTensorMetadata build_metadata_from_local_shards( local_shards: list[Shard], global_size: torch.Size, current_rank: int, pg: c10d.ProcessGroup, )
methods.description: Constructs local sharded tensor metadata from local shard tensors and their metadata, validating tensor properties.

methods.name: build_global_metadata( gathered_metadatas: Sequence[ShardedTensorMetadata | None], recalc_metadata: bool = False, )
methods.description: Aggregates local shard metadata from all ranks into a global sharded tensor metadata, performing validation and consistency checks.

methods.name: None recalc_global_sharded_tensor_metadata( global_sharded_tensor_metadata: ShardedTensorMetadata, sharded_dim: int )
methods.description: Recalculates the global metadata for a sharded tensor, updating shard offsets and the overall size based on shard placement.

ctags.signature: ( my_rank: int, dst_rank: int, size: torch.Size, dst_tensor: torch.Tensor | None, )

ctags.name: build_global_metadata
ctags.signature: ( gathered_metadatas: Sequence[ShardedTensorMetadata | None], recalc_metadata: bool = False, )

ctags.name: build_metadata_from_local_shards
ctags.signature: ( local_shards: list[Shard], global_size: torch.Size, current_rank: int, pg: c10d.ProcessGroup, )
